svg.title: Fixed-output feature contributions
svg.desc: football-csv | PL | fixed output H - A | 32 holdout rows 2026-03-21 to 2026-04-25 | model 248ab51bf6b5 | run 3c493184a1e17c956bc9 Dots are matches, with one fixed output across the cohort. Native tree path statistics; no causal or probability-point interpretation. Top 12 features shown; the CSV contains every feature, original input value, contribution, main effect and baseline.
